mapper.select: select mu.merchant_id, m.name as merchant_name, m.status as merchant_status, mu.role, mu.status as membership_status from merchant_users mu join merchants m on m.id = mu.merchant_id where mu.user_id = #{userId} order by case mu.role when 'OWNER' then 0 when 'ADMIN' then 1 else 2 end, m.name asc, m.id asc

select u.user_id, u.user_name, u.phone_masked, mu.role, mu.status, mu.create_time as join_time from merchant_users mu join sys_user u on u.user_id = mu.user_id where mu.merchant_id = #{merchantId} order by case mu.role when 'OWNER' then 0 when 'ADMIN' then 1 else 2 end, mu.create_time asc, u.user_id asc
mapper.update: update merchant_users set role = #{role}, status = #{status}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = now() where merchant_id = #{merchantId} and user_id = #{userId}
update merchant_users set role = 'ADMIN', update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = now() where merchant_id = #{merchantId} and user_id != #{exceptUserId} and role = 'OWNER'
mapper.delete: delete from merchant_users where merchant_id = #{merchantId} and user_id = #{userId}
mapper.select: select count(1) from merchant_users where merchant_id = #{merchantId} and status = 'ENABLED'
